hook: Procore, a construction software company, just hit a 78 percent success rate on construction tasks.

sections.voiceover: Procore, a construction software company, just hit a 78 percent success rate on construction tasks.
sections.visual_cue: Large bold text overlay showing 78 percent success rate.
b_roll: Abstract data visualization of construction progress.

sections.voiceover: Does this beat the 60 percent benchmark set by general-purpose frontier models used for tasks?
sections.visual_cue: Split screen showing a construction site blueprint and a server rack.
b_roll: Construction site blueprints on a digital screen.

sections.voiceover: However, Construction Metrics published benchmark data in October 2026 showing general models scored lower.
sections.visual_cue: Bar chart comparing 78 percent against 60 percent.

sections.voiceover: The closest frontier model only reached a 60 percent success rate during the same testing cycle. Magpie 3.0, Procore's new reasoning engine, outperformed general-purpose frontier models across 200 construction tasks.
sections.visual_cue: Graph showing the 60 percent benchmark line versus the 78 percent performance.
b_roll: Graph highlighting the 18 percentage point gap.

sections.voiceover: Magpie 3.0 now leads with that 78 percent task success rate.
sections.visual_cue: Final screen showing the 78 percent figure clearly.
b_roll: Close up of 78 percent on a dashboard.
